pages.text: The proposed Transformer architecture replaces recurrent and convolutional sequence models with attention mechanisms. The encoder and decoder are constructed from stacked layers.
Scaled dot-product attention computes query-key dot products, divides by the square root of the key dimension, applies softmax, and combines the values.
Multi-head attention linearly projects queries, keys, and values into several representation subspaces. The heads operate in parallel and their outputs are concatenated.
Sinusoidal positional encoding adds sine and cosine signals at different frequencies so the model can represent absolute and relative token positions.
Training uses the Adam optimizer with a scheduled learning rate. The rate increases during warmup steps and then decreases with inverse square-root decay.
Machine translation experiments report BLEU results on the WMT 2014 English-to-German and English-to-French benchmarks.
